title: release-train-weekly-prep-notes - 2026-03-31
content:
Weekly release-train prep notes (working / scratchpad)
Date: 2026-03-31
Owner: Arjun Mehta
Attendees (planned): Maya, Taylor, Samir, Priya (on-call), Eng leads as needed

Agenda (quick)
- Quick status: blocker highlights (2 min)
- Go/No-Go checklist walkthrough (10 min)
- Rollout plan and canary windows (5 min)
- Final open risks + mitigations (5 min)
- Action items and owners (5 min)

Context / headline
- Target launch window: 2026-04-03 18:00 PDT (customer-facing rollout).
- Current train: infra + serving-runtime + console patches. Several infra PRs merged yesterday but one infra change (INFRA-210) introduced intermittent scheduler throttling in staging	5 flagged as high risk.

Quick status (by area)
- Serving runtime: feature parity for KV cache fix merged (PR#1284). Smoke tests passing locally; staging shows +2% median latency during long sequences but within SLO. Owner: Maya.
- Console & rollouts: UI changes for rollout controls are shipped, e2e flaky (timeout in CI). Owner: Taylor.
- Dedicated infra: INFRA-210 deployment to staging caused occasional scheduler throttles under synthetic load. Root cause suspected in autoscaler tuning; rollback candidate available. Owner: Samir.
- Integrations: KMS rotation test scheduled tomorrow morning; might cause brief auth errors during rotation window	5 notify SRE. Owner: Priya.

Go / No-Go checklist (walk through in meeting)
- [ ] All critical PRs merged and smoke-tested in staging (owners listed) -- Maya/Taylor/Samir
- [ ] E2E tests passing or known flakes tracked (link to CI runs) -- Taylor
- [ ] Infra incidents resolved or rollback plan ready -- Samir (BLOCKER: INFRA-210 throttle observed)
- [ ] Monitoring & alerts validated for new metrics (token latency, scheduler queue) -- SRE (Charlie)
- [ ] Rollout plan (canary %) and auto-fallback configured -- Release-engineering (Arjun)
- [ ] Customer communication drafted (if any risk to external SLAs) -- PM (Leah)

Notes on the INFRA-210 issue (high priority)
- Symptom: under 1200 concurrent synthetic sessions, scheduler queue grows and some workers report throttled task creation. Not seen in dev or prod-sim earlier.
- Immediate mitigation: revert INFRA-210 to previous autoscaler config or deploy emergency patch that tightens backoff. Both available.
- Impact if not resolved: increased latency and potential OOMs on low-memory instances in Dedicated pools during burst.
- Proposed decision in meeting: Rollback INFRA-210 in staging now, hold prod rollout until we validate backoff patch in staging + 2h soak.

Open questions / unresolved
- Do we have a runbook update for scheduler throttles? (SRE follow-up)
- Is customer communication required for potential ~10-15m outage during KMS rotation window? (PM to advise)
- Canary size: 5% or 10%? Prefer start at 5% given recent infra instability.

Action items (from previous week)
- Maya: finish long-sequence perf run on staging (in progress)	5 ETA: 2026-03-31 morning.
- Taylor: triage flaky e2e and post list of top 3 flakes (done, see CI notes).
- Samir: investigate INFRA-210, prepare rollback plan (in progress)	5 ETA: today EOD.
- Arjun: draft rollout playbook and fallback thresholds (in progress)	5 link: Confluence /launch/readiness-checklist

New action items (post-meeting)
- Samir: perform staging rollback of INFRA-210 and run 3-hour soak. Due: 2026-03-31 16:00.
- Maya: validate KV cache fix under long sequences and push latency histogram to dashboard. Due: 2026-03-31 15:30.
- Taylor: stabilize e2e or mark known flakes and add gating to rollout. Due: 2026-03-31 17:00.
- Priya: schedule KMS rotation run in a low-traffic window and notify SRE/CS. Due: 2026-04-01 09:00.
- Arjun: final go/no-go decision call at 2026-04-01 12:00 PDT (30m).

Risks & mitigations (short)
- Risk: Scheduler throttling (INFRA-210) -> Mitigation: rollback in staging, hold prod.
- Risk: E2E flakes hide regressions -> Mitigation: explicit gating for known flaky tests, manual smoke in staging.
- Risk: Auth blips during KMS rotation -> Mitigation: stagger rotation, on-call present, rollback KMS keys ready.

Misc notes / scratch (to capture during meeting)
- If rollback happens, need to check release notes and include in postmortem timeline.
- Keep customer_success in loop if any SLA impact visible.
- Slack thread to watch: #release-train (pin INFRA-210 logs).

Links / quick refs
- REL-482 (launch ticket): https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/REL-482
- INFRA-210: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFRA-210
- PR#1284: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/1284
- Readiness checklist: Confluence /launch/readiness-checklist

Notes-to-self: keep this doc lightweight. Move finalized checklist to Confluence after go/no-go decision.
